title: Angel Sanctuary
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Setsuna, a troubled 16-year-old, is in love with his 15-year-old sister Sara and learns he is the reincarnation of Alexiel, an angel who rebelled against Heaven. He is drawn into a war among angels and demons that takes him through Hell and Heaven in search of Sara's soul, and ends in a confrontation with God himself. The author names 'forbidden love' as the theme, and the series also explores good and evil, nature versus science, and gender.
life_message: Love, even a love the world forbids, is worth defying Heaven's order for, and good and evil are not sorted neatly by rank.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Setsuna 'will fight anyone anytime' (Viz blurb); vengeance and personal combat run through the war.

Order vs freedom.evidence: Setsuna ignores all authority; Alexiel's rebellion and the defeat of God celebrate defiance of imposed order.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Setsuna's bond with Sara outweighs Heaven, Hell and humanity; Rosiel and Alexiel's twin bond drives the plot.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Heaven's rigid ranks are shown as cruel; the oppressed Evils win sympathy (Class Struggle tag).

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Religious figures are reimagined freely; inherited religion is questioned rather than followed.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Love and identity over safety, though survival in a cosmic war dominates much of the plot.

folkways.japan: Christian and Jewish figures (angels, Lucifer, God) are used as aesthetic and mythic material, as is common in 1990s Japanese gothic shoujo, rather than as a statement about those faiths.

delivery.evidence: Author names 'forbidden love' as theme; reviewers praise dense, twisty plot and note shock factors, not sermons (Wikipedia reception).

personified.ideology: Absolute divine authority that would destroy humanity

delivery.note: Critics say both angels and demons get positive and negative traits, but the story's final verdict falls against Heaven's authority.

winners_losers: Setsuna and Sara are reunited after Setsuna defeats God with Lucifer's help; Heaven's rulers and the order they enforce lose. Sympathy goes to forbidden love and rebellion against a tyrannical hierarchy.
